import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 33;
    static final double eps = 1e-8;
    static final double pi = Math.acos(-1.0);
    static final long inf = 0xFFFFFFF;
    static final long mod = 1000000007L;

    static int r;
    static int K;
    static long n;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] a = new long[N][N];

        void toZero() {
            for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < r; j++) {
                    a[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void toE() {
            toZero();
            for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
                a[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        static Matrix multiply(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
            Matrix ret = new Matrix();
            ret.toZero();
            for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < r; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < r; k++) {
                        ret.a[i][j] = (ret.a[i][j] + a.a[i][k] * b.a[k][j]) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static Matrix[] one = new Matrix[70];
    static Matrix[] two = new Matrix[70];
    static Matrix[] rotr = new Matrix[70];
    static Matrix[] rotc = new Matrix[70];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextInt();
        r = K + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i <= K + 1; i++) {
            one[i] = new Matrix();
            one[i].toE();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            if (one[i] == null) one[i] = new Matrix();
            one[i].toE();
            if (i > 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                    one[i].a[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            rotr[i] = new Matrix();
            rotr[i].toE();
            if (i == 1) {
                rotr[i].toZero();
                rotr[i].a[0][0] = 1;
                rotr[i].a[1][K] = 1;
                for (int j = 2; j <= K; j++) {
                    rotr[i].a[j][j - 1] = 1;
                }
            } else if (i > 1) {
                rotr[i] = Matrix.multiply(rotr[1], rotr[i - 1]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            rotc[i] = new Matrix();
            rotc[i].toE();
            if (i == 1) {
                rotc[i].toZero();
                rotc[i].a[0][0] = 1;
                rotc[i].a[K][1] = 1;
                for (int j = 2; j <= K; j++) {
                    rotc[i].a[j - 1][j] = 1;
                }
            } else if (i > 1) {
                rotc[i] = Matrix.multiply(rotc[i - 1], rotc[1]);
            }
        }

        two[1] = new Matrix();
        two[1].toE();
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            two[1] = Matrix.multiply(one[i], two[1]);
        }

        int bit = 0;
        int[] num = new int[70];
        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            num[bit++] = (int)(tempN % K);
            tempN /= K;
        }

        for (int i = 2; i <= bit; i++) {
            two[i] = new Matrix();
            two[i].toE();
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                two[i] = Matrix.multiply(Matrix.multiply(rotr[j], two[i - 1]), Matrix.multiply(rotc[j], two[i]));
            }
        }

        // Reverse num array
        for (int i = 0; i < bit / 2; i++) {
            int tmp = num[i];
            num[i] = num[bit - i - 1];
            num[bit - i - 1] = tmp;
        }

        Matrix ret = new Matrix();
        ret.toE();

        int ps = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < bit; i++) {
            if (i == bit - 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < num[i]; j++) {
                    ret = Matrix.multiply(one[ps % K + 1], ret);
                    ps++;
                }
            } else {
                for (int j = 0; j < num[i]; j++) {
                    ret = Matrix.multiply(Matrix.multiply(rotr[ps % K], Matrix.multiply(two[bit - i - 1], Matrix.multiply(rotc[ps % K], ret))));
                    ps++;
                }
            }
        }

        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            res = (res + ret.a[i][0]) % mod;
        }

        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
